resources.string: Per-installation mod optimization through Modrinth. Independent from the Ultra-Lite profile.

Ultra-Optimization checks the selected installation against the official Modrinth API, then installs only the missing optimization mods that match this exact Minecraft version and loader. It never changes the renderer, the Java runtime, or your existing mods.
Select an installation on the main screen, then re-scan.
Working… The progress bar shows the current step only.
Enabled: %1$d mod file(s) installed by Ultra-Optimization
Ultra-Lite launcher profile: %1$s (global, not changed here)

Ultra-Optimization will download %1$d verified file(s) into the mods folder of "%2$s".\n\nNothing is removed, renamed, or overwritten: files that already exist are skipped. A backup log is kept inside the installation so this can be undone.
This removes only the %1$d file(s) that Ultra-Optimization installed and puts back any file it displaced. Your own mods, config files and other installations are not touched.
Cancelled. Files that were already installed stay installed and are listed above.
Nothing to install: every compatible mod is already present or was skipped.
A scan or install is already running for this screen.
No verified plan is available. Re-scan first; nothing was installed.
